gen-space-mono-fs-erode: Erode reads as an editorial text serif with a broad mouth on g and a, plus a gentle thick-to-thin pulse. Space Mono then holds a quirky, fixed-width line of unchanging stroke against that modest contrast.
gen-space-mono-manrope: Space Mono stamps quirky, technical letters on a fixed-width grid. Manrope, a sans, prefers a slightly reduced size, its open mouths and nearly cap-high lowercase holding one pen width.
gen-ultra-fs-chillax: Closed blade-slot openings and packed vintage letters mark Ultra sitting over Chillax and its unfinished spaghetti loops. The spark is closed serif slots against an open, relaxed plain sans.
gen-ultra-fs-epilogue: Vintage Ultra packs closed blade-slot letters tightly over Epilogue. Epilogue, a sans-serif, brings unclamped curves and stubby-ascender lowercase that fill the line beside those packed serifs.
gen-ultra-fs-merriweather-sans: Merriweather Sans, a sans-serif, looks sturdy, with an e that opens clearly rightward under Ultra. Merriweather Sans then meets packed, closed serif slots with a high, open lowercase.
gen-ultra-general-sans: General Sans comes across clean, a plain sans whose x-height fills the line and whose bends never snag. And size that body down a notch under Ultra's packed, slightly contrasted serifs.
gen-ultra-gf-padyakke-expanded-one: Authoritative curves spread like slack-rope knots in Padyakke Expanded One under Ultra. And the spark is Ultra's slight candle-flame taper against that unmodulated, widely spaced classic serif.
gen-ultra-switzer: Packed vintage slots mark Ultra over Switzer, a tubular, wire-like sans-serif. And Switzer's open c tips rest against those closed blade-slot serifs without crowding the column.
gen-ultra-work-sans: Stems that slightly outweigh hairlines mark Ultra over Work Sans. Work Sans, a sans-serif, holds open c tips and stem-heavy joins, while Ultra stays shut, vintage, packed.
gen-yeseva-one-fs-merriweather-sans: Fat bowls on hairline joins: that is Yeseva One over Merriweather Sans. Merriweather Sans, a plain sans, keeps a longer stretch sturdy, with an e that opens clearly rightward.
gen-yeseva-one-gf-bhutuka-expanded-one: Yeseva One plants vintage, bookish fat bowls on hairline joins over BhuTuka Expanded One and its unclamped curves. Drop that serif a size, its unclamped curves walking at a leisurely pace.
gen-yeseva-one-manrope: Bookish fat bowls on hairline joins sit in Yeseva One over Manrope. Manrope, a plain sans, holds one pen width and open mouths while those vintage bowls shout in a few large words.
gen-yeseva-one-switzer: Switzer, a Swiss plain sans, shows tubular, wire-like letters and open c tips under Yeseva One. Yeseva One shouts in fat bowls; Switzer holds the open running line.
gen-young-serif-fs-chillax: Chillax, a casual plain sans, lays spaghetti letters with unfinished loops under Young Serif. Chillax wants a smaller size, its matching horizontals and verticals against that friendly serif.
gen-young-serif-fs-merriweather-sans: Friendly serif against a sturdy sans: Young Serif over Merriweather Sans, with an e that opens rightward. Made large, that body looks sturdier under a small heading.
